# contraco

> Premium transformation consulting combining strategic clarity, technological intelligence, and psychological depth. Founded 1998 by Frank Meltke.

contraco is a premium transformation consultancy headquartered in Ava, Missouri, USA, with a presence in Leipzig, Germany. The firm has served more than 50 global brands across 30 countries.

## Focus

contraco works at the intersection where distribution architecture meets liability, in the moment AI agents begin buying on their own behalf.

- Agentic commerce governance: maturity, the control layer, the delegation chain, auditability.
- Attribution and liability: who is bound when an autonomous agent makes a declaration, and what follows for configuration, approvals and documentation.
- AI visibility: product data, enrichment, and why offers stay invisible to agents.
- Travel distribution: what happens when agents no longer reach the booking screen.

## Methodology

The Resonance Method is contraco's proprietary framework for digital transformation, developed over 28 years. It addresses a three-dimensional execution gap: strategic clarity, technological intelligence, and psychological depth.

## Founder

Frank Meltke, German inventor, Wikidata Q139680598, patent DE10313420A1 (2003), guest lecturer Kyung Hee University Seoul, Insight Panelist BBC Global Minds.

- [Frank Meltke](https://meltke.com)
- [Practitioner Notes on AI Governance](https://signal.meltke.com)
- [Agentic Commerce Research](https://agentic.contraco.net)

## Languages

contraco publishes across four domains: [English](https://contraco.net), [German](https://contraco.de), [Russian](https://contraco.ru), [Korean](https://contraco.co.kr).
